text:
sam_sales: Heads-up — FinBank wants installation in a physically isolated DC next month. They're pushing for a documented upgrade cadence, delta bundle plan, and answers for a security questionnaire from their CISO. Can eng/ops confirm what we can promise for packaging and hotfixes?

maria_secu: Thanks. Two quick asks from security: 1) Do we support customer-managed HSM/KMS in air-gapped mode? 2) Can we provide tamper-evident bundle signing + audit logs? If yes, what's the integration effort?

alex_eng: Short version: yes to both with caveats. We support KMS/HSM integration for Private if customer exposes an API gateway. For fully isolated sites we support signed bundles + offline verification. Integration effort depends on HSM model — typical work: 2-4 engineering days for the connector + testing.

alex_eng: For packaging/upgrade cadence we recommend: minor security/hotfixes: ad-hoc (within 2 weeks) via signed delta bundles; regular functional releases: quarterly. We can do emergency patches faster but SLA needs to cover courier/USB options.

alex_eng: Delta bundle notes:
- Bundles are additive patches, signed with our release key.
- We provide SHA256 manifest and detached signature.
- Client-side verification uses our verifier CLI.

alex_eng: Example verification:
```
redwood-verify --manifest manifest.json --sig manifest.sig --key vendor.pub
cat manifest.json | jq .bundles[] | xargs -n1 sha256sum -c
```

ops_jen: Operational constraints: shipping window depends on image size. Typical delta ~150MB-600MB. For customers refusing any egress, we'll provide physical media with notarized manifest. Need 3-4 business days to produce signed USB shipment.

maria_secu: Notes for questionnaire: we'll state 'supports customer-managed KMS with connector' and 'bundles are signed & verifiable; audit logs retained for 12 months' — confirm retention policy.

legal_jk: On pricing: reserved work for custom HSM connector + physical media are billable. We should propose an SOW line item: "airgap integration & signing setup" (est. 3-5 days eng + ops shipping). Also flag export restrictions on some crypto hardware.

sam_sales: Thanks. Next steps: alex, can you draft a short SOW paragraph + an ops checklist? Maria, can you draft the security answers we'll give to the customer? Legal, can you add the billing snippet? I'll package and send to FinBank tomorrow EOD.

alex_eng: Will do. I'll drop a 1‑page SOW and sample manifest by EOD. Expect a minimal checklist: requirements (jumpbox, admin creds, allowed USB), verification steps, rollback steps.

ops_jen: I'll add shipping lead times and packaging options to the checklist.

deploy_bot: Deploy note: release/v2.3.1 - signed-bundles support - merged by @alex_eng - CI artifacts: s3://releases/airgap/v2.3.1/

sam_sales: Great — tagging FinBank contact. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
